patterns.reproduced_strategy: order_idor: two authenticated sessions (owner + non-owner) read the same per-user order resource; cross-account access reproduced when the non-owner receives the owner's exact object (verified against the owner's authorized view).

coupon_abuse: a client-supplied coupon code the shop never issued is trusted and applied to the cart; reproduced when an in-scope order-status read-back shows the illegitimate discount durably persisted on the order.

payment_status_trust: the order's own status endpoint trusts a client-supplied status and persists it without settlement; reproduced when an in-scope order-status read-back shows the order durably marked (e.g. paid) that the client set directly.

refund_abuse: the order's refund endpoint trusts a client-supplied amount and adds it to the order's refunded total with no amount or idempotency check; reproduced when an in-scope refund-status read-back shows the order's refunded total durably exceeding the amount paid.

race_condition: a single-use store-credit voucher redemption guards with a non-atomic check-then-act (read the applied-count, then grant credit) and no lock or idempotency key, so a bounded, gated concurrent burst can bypass the guard. Reproduced only if an in-scope read-back shows the operation durably applied more than once this run; because a genuine race is non-deterministic this is usually INCONCLUSIVE — a human-review lead, never evidence the race is absent.
